temu_product_search.name: temu_product_search
temu_product_search.description: Search product data on the Temu e-commerce platform with multi-dimensional filtering, sorted by monthly sales count descending.

node_id.description: Optional. If specified: limit the search scope to the specified category and its sub-categories (the specified category nodeId is not limited to leaf categories).

brand.description: Optional. If specified: query hot-selling products of the specified brand.

seller_name.description: Optional. If specified: query hot-selling products of the specified seller.

cumulative_sale_count_min.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose cumulative sales count is greater than or equal to this value.

cumulative_sale_count_max.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose cumulative sales count is less than or equal to this value.

sale_count_min.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose monthly sales count is greater than or equal to this value.

sale_count_max.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose monthly sales count is less than or equal to this value.

sale_amount_min.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose monthly sales amount is greater than or equal to this value.

sale_amount_max.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose monthly sales amount is less than or equal to this value.

sale_count_mom_min.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose month-over-month growth is greater than or equal to this value (in %).

sale_count_mom_max.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose month-over-month growth is less than or equal to this value (in %).

price_min.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose selling price is greater than or equal to this value.

price_max.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose selling price is less than or equal to this value.

manage_type.description: Optional. If specified: filter products by management type.

comment_count_min.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose comment count is greater than or equal to this value.

comment_count_max.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose comment count is less than or equal to this value.

star_min.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose star rating is greater than or equal to this value.

star_max.description: Optional. If specified: filter products whose star rating is less than or equal to this value.

sale_time_min.description: Optional. If specified: filter products by listing start date (yyyy-MM-dd).

sale_time_max.description: Optional. If specified: filter products by listing end date (yyyy-MM-dd).

page.description: Pagination, at most 20 products per page. Defaults to 1 (page index starts from 1, not 0).

temu_category_tree.name: temu_category_tree
temu_category_tree.description: Query the product category structure on the Temu platform.

node_id.description: Optional: if specified, returns the child categories of this node_id; if not specified, returns the top-level and second-level categories. Data type: string.

temu_product_search_from_name.name: temu_product_search_from_name
temu_product_search_from_name.description: Search Temu products by name, returning 20 products per call.

name.description: The product name to search for.

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1.

walmart_product_detail_by_product_id.name: walmart_product_detail_by_product_id
walmart_product_detail_by_product_id.description: Query the details of a product on the Walmart e-commerce platform.

product_id.description: Product ID, single product ID query only.

product_search.name: product_search
product_search.description: Search the real-time product data on the Amazon platform, sorted by monthly sales volume in descending order by default.

seasonal_popular_product.description: Optional: filter products that are in peak season in the specified month. Defaults to Both.

brand.description: Optional: filter products of the specified brand.

seller_name.description: Optional: filter products of the specified seller.

search_name.description: Optional: search related products by this name.

property_name.description: Optional: filter products whose title or attributes contain the specified property.

price_min.description: Optional: filter products with selling price greater than or equal to this value.

price_max.description: Optional: filter products with selling price less than or equal to this value.

month_sales_volume_min.description: Optional: filter products with monthly sales volume greater than or equal to this value.

month_sales_volume_max.description: Optional: filter products with monthly sales volume less than or equal to this value.

ratings_min.description: Optional: filter products with star rating greater than or equal to this value.

ratings_max.description: Optional: filter products with star rating less than or equal to this value.

ratings_count_min.description: Optional: filter products with review count greater than or equal to this value.

ratings_count_max.description: Optional: filter products with review count less than or equal to this value.

subcategory_sales_volume_rank_min.description: Optional: filter products whose sales volume rank in the subcategory is greater than or equal to this value.

subcategory_sales_volume_rank_max.description: Optional: filter products whose sales volume rank in the subcategory is less than or equal to this value.

delivery_type.description: Optional: filter products by fulfillment method. Allowed values: `Both` (default, no filter), `FBM` (seller-fulfilled), `FBA` (any product using Amazon FBA, including seller-shipped and third-party like 1688), `AmzFBA` (third-party seller using Amazon FBA, e.g. 1688).

variation_count_min.description: Optional: filter products whose variation (child ASIN) count is greater than or equal to this value.

variation_count_max.description: Optional: filter products whose variation (child ASIN) count is less than or equal to this value.

sortby_potential_index.description: Optional: if true, sort by the product's potential index from high to low.

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 20 records.

product_trend.name: product_trend
product_trend.description: Query the historical trend of a product on the Amazon platform, supporting monthly sales volume/amount, price, top-category rank trends, and sub-category rank trends.

product_trend_type.description: Product trend type to query. Allowed values: SalesVolume (monthly sales volume), SalesAmount (monthly sales amount), Price, Rank (main category ranking), BsrRank (subcategory ranking);  Defaults to SalesVolume.

search_categories_broadly.name: search_categories_broadly
search_categories_broadly.description: Broadly search sub-category markets that match multi-dimensional constraints, for multi-dimensional product selection.

month_sales_volume_min.description: Optional: filter sub-category markets whose monthly sales volume is greater than or equal to this value.

month_sales_volume_max.description: Optional: filter sub-category markets whose monthly sales volume is less than or equal to this value.

ratings_min.description: Optional: filter sub-category markets whose star rating is greater than or equal to this value.

ratings_max.description: Optional: filter sub-category markets whose star rating is less than or equal to this value.

ratings_count_min.description: Optional: filter sub-category markets whose review count is greater than or equal to this value.

ratings_count_max.description: Optional: filter sub-category markets whose review count is less than or equal to this value.

price_min.description: Optional: filter sub-category markets whose average selling price (local currency) is greater than or equal to this value.

price_max.description: Optional: filter sub-category markets whose average selling price (local currency) is less than or equal to this value.

seasonal_popular_product.description: Optional: filter sub-categories whose peak season is the given month. Defaults to Both.

top3_product_sales_share_min.description: Optional: use 0-1 to indicate percentage (e.g. 10% = 0.1). Filter sub-category markets whose top-3 products sales-volume share of top-100 (sales-monopoly index) is greater than or equal to this value.

top3_product_sales_share_max.description: Optional: use 0-1 to indicate percentage (e.g. 10% = 0.1). Filter sub-category markets whose top-3 products sales-volume share of top-100 (sales-monopoly index) is less than or equal to this value.

amazon_owned_sales_share_min.description: Optional: use 0-1 to indicate percentage (e.g. 10% = 0.1). Filter sub-category markets whose Amazon-owned products sales-volume share within top-100 (seller-monopoly index) is greater than or equal to this value.

amazon_owned_sales_share_max.description: Optional: use 0-1 to indicate percentage (e.g. 10% = 0.1). Filter sub-category markets whose Amazon-owned products sales-volume share within top-100 (seller-monopoly index) is less than or equal to this value.

top100_top400_sales_share_min.description: Optional: use 0-1 to indicate percentage (e.g. 10% = 0.1). Filter sub-category markets whose top-100 products sales-volume share within top-400 (lower share = longer-tail) is greater than or equal to this value.

top100_top400_sales_share_max.description: Optional: use 0-1 to indicate percentage (e.g. 10% = 0.1). Filter sub-category markets whose top-100 products sales-volume share within top-400 (lower share = longer-tail) is less than or equal to this value.

newproduct_sales_share_min.description: Optional: use 0-1 to indicate percentage (e.g. 10% = 0.1). Filter sub-category markets whose new-product sales-volume share (products listed within 3 months) within top-100 is greater than or equal to this value.

newproduct_sales_share_max.description: Optional: use 0-1 to indicate percentage (e.g. 10% = 0.1). Filter sub-category markets whose new-product sales-volume share (products listed within 3 months) within top-100 is less than or equal to this value.

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 20 records.

shopee_category_trend.name: shopee_category_trend
shopee_category_trend.description: Used to query the historical trend of a Shopee category market. Each call returns one trend dimension; select the trendIndex enum accordingly.

node_id.description: The category node ID to query.

trend_index.description: The historical trend type to query.

rank_max.description: Optional: filter keywords whose weekly search-volume rank is less than or equal to this value.

search_volume_max.description: Optional: filter keywords whose monthly search volume is less than or equal to this value.

potential_product.name: potential_product
potential_product.description: (隐赚指数选品) Search for potential products on the Amazon platform.

price_min.description: Optional: filter products with selling price greater than or equal to this value.

price_max.description: Optional: filter products with selling price less than or equal to this value.

month_sales_volume_min.description: Optional: filter products with monthly sales volume greater than or equal to this value.

month_sales_volume_max.description: Optional: filter products with monthly sales volume less than or equal to this value.

delivery_type.description: Optional: filter products by fulfillment method. Allowed values: `Both` (default, no filter), `FBM` (seller-fulfilled), `FBA` (any product using Amazon FBA, including seller-shipped and third-party like 1688), `AmzFBA` (third-party seller using Amazon FBA, e.g. 1688).

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 20 records.

walmart_keyword_search_results.description: Query the natural-position product list in the last 15 days' search results for a hot-search keyword on the Walmart e-commerce platform.

reddit_post_search.name: reddit_post_search
reddit_post_search.description: Search social media posts related to a specified product or keyword to learn what users really say — complaints, reviews, and usage discussions; returns up to 20 posts per call.

post_type.description: Filter by post type, multiple values separated by commas. Allowed: 1=Question/Help, 2=Purchase Advice, 3=Complaint, 4=Experience Sharing, 5=Discussion, 6=Innovation, 7=Other.

main_sentiment.description: Filter by main post sentiment. Allowed: 1=Positive, 2=Neutral, 3=Negative.

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 20 records.

ali1688_product_search_from_image.name: ali1688_product_search_from_image
ali1688_product_search_from_image.description: Search products on the 1688 platform by image.

image_url.description: Image URL, required. Must pass a web image URL, and the image size must not exceed 1MB.

page.description: Which page of data to query, defaults to page 1.

walmart_product_traffic_terms.name: walmart_product_traffic_terms

walmart_product_trend_by_product_id.description: Query the historical trend data of a product on the Walmart e-commerce platform, supports multi-dimensional trend analysis such as monthly sales volume / sales amount / price / rank / reviews / star rating.

shopee_category_request.description: Query Best Seller products under a Shopee category. Optional queryDate for historical review (only sub-categories supported).

node_id.description: The category ID to look up.

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 20 records.

repurchase_rate_min.description: Filter products with repurchase rate greater than or equal to this value.

service_score_min.description: Filter products with overall service score greater than or equal to this value.

service_score_max.description: Filter products with overall service score less than or equal to this value.

sku_count_min.description: Filter products with SKU count greater than or equal to this value.

sku_count_max.description: Filter products with SKU count less than or equal to this value.

stock_count_min.description: Filter products with stock count greater than or equal to this value.

stock_count_max.description: Filter products with stock count less than or equal to this value.

online_date_range_min.description: Filter products by listing start date, date format yyyy-MM-dd.

online_date_range_max.description: Filter products by listing end date, date format yyyy-MM-dd.

shopee_product_request.description: Query detailed information of a Shopee product.

variation_count_range_min.description: Optional. If specified: limit minimum variation count.
